_comment: What an unattended build session is allowed to do. scripts/autopilot.mjs spawns
`claude -p --permission-mode dontAsk`, which auto-DENIES anything not listed here.
That is the point: a headless run cannot answer a permission prompt, so without
this list a session can edit files but cannot run its QA, cannot commit and cannot
tick its own card — which is exactly what happened on the first FL10 run.
Compound commands are checked per subcommand: `node qa.mjs | tail -5` needs BOTH
`node *` and `tail *`. That is why the ordinary shell plumbing is listed.
defaultMode is deliberately NOT set here, so interactive sessions keep their
normal behaviour. Only the runner opts into dontAsk, on the command line.
